params.body: The major-upgrade hand's first run on afrodidact (12 September) asked the gateway for `branch.delete` and the ticket, which named the repair hands' three verbs, refused it. The hand's verbs differ: it starts no runner, and it needs two the repair hands never do: `branch.delete` for a branch whose checks went red, and `pull.ready` (control v0.14.0) for the draft it opens when the branch alone draws no run. The ticket for that playbook now names those four and nothing more; the other hands' tickets are unchanged, and a test pins each hand's list.
params.title: The major-upgrade ticket names its own four verbs
